# Desktop 26.924 codex-cli layout recovery

## Result

Codex Desktop stopped opening on `26.924.22138`. The app showed
`应用已暂停，等待安全加载组织设置后才能恢复` (`Organization settings could not be
loaded`, `desktop.workspacePolicyRecovery`). Root cause was the runtime launcher,
not the network: Desktop `26.924` replaced the bundled CLI `0.155.0-alpha.16.4`
with `0.158.0-alpha.2.1` and moved it from `Contents/Resources/codex` into
`Contents/Resources/codex-cli` (`codex-package.json`, `layoutVersion` 1,
entrypoint `bin/codex`). The installed launcher still used the removed legacy
path, exited `127`, and Desktop's app-server startup policy read never
completed.

## Changes

- `router_manager.resolve_official_codex` resolves the bundled backend on every
  run (explicit override, legacy `Resources/codex`, then the `codex-cli`
  layout), and `--official-codex` is now optional.
- `runtime/templates/codex-router` resolves the same candidates in shell, so an
  app update cannot strand `CODEX_CLI_PATH` on a removed path.
- `bundled_code_mode_host` searches the entrypoint directory, `codex-cli/bin`,
  the app bundle, and the legacy `Resources` directory.
- `updater_watch_paths` watches the bundled binary plus the `codex-cli` layout
  directory when present.
- `bin/codex-provider` asks the manager for the resolved path, and
  `resolve-official-codex` exposes it for scripts.
- New `OfficialCodexLayoutTests` cover legacy preference, entrypoint detection,
  app-bundle fallback, explicit override, code-mode-host resolution, and updater
  watch paths. Compatibility docs, operations runbook, and the backlog record
  the new layout and the Desktop startup symptom.

## Validation

- Repository self-test: 50 passed.
- `codex-provider status`: `official_binary` =
  `/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin/codex`,
  `official_version` = `0.158.0-alpha.2.1`.
- `codex-router --version` returns `codex-cli 0.158.0-alpha.2.1` and the
  launcher logs `version mismatch (official=0.158.0-alpha.2.1
  custom=0.155.0-alpha.16.4); using official backend` (fail-closed).
- Desktop reopened: the app-server starts from the launcher and answers
  `config/read`, `configRequirements/read`, `account/read`, `model/list`, and
  `thread/list`, so the startup policy gate is satisfied and no recovery dialog
  appears.

## Risk

- DeepSeek routing stays disabled until the updater certifies a release built
  for `0.158.0-alpha.2.1`; the launcher keeps using the official backend until
  then. Desktop must be fully quit and reopened after that activation.
- The merged model catalog is still the `0.155` snapshot; run
  `codex-provider sync-models` after the rebuild to pick up official model
  changes from `0.158`.
